UPDATE automation.delivery
               SET status = 'pending',
                   attempts = 0,
                   next_attempt_at = now(),
                   last_error = NULL,
                   completed_at = NULL,
                   locked_at = NULL,
                   locked_by = NULL
               WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2 AND status IN ('dead', 'failed', 'succeeded')
